title: Most news feeds are broken because they treat everyone the same.
body:
We are drowning in noise. Every day, thousands of stories compete for our attention, but very few of them actually matter to our specific lives or interests. Most algorithms are designed to keep you scrolling by showing you what is popular or inflammatory. They prioritize engagement over substance.

The problem is not that there is too much news. The problem is that the news we get is rarely relevant to who we are. True personalization should not be about creating echo chambers. It should be about filtering out the noise so you can focus on the topics that help you grow, work better, or understand the world around you.

Imagine a feed that learns what you care about and ignores the rest. No clickbait, no outrage farming, just the information you need to stay informed. We think the future of news is about giving you back your time. It is time to move past the one-size-fits-all approach and build something that actually respects your intelligence.
cta: We are building that at HEADLINNE.com.
